title: PowerScope: Fine-Grained Power Management for Heterogeneous Processors
problem: Heterogeneous multi-core processors require efficient power management techniques that can coordinate across different core types. Existing approaches fail to jointly optimize voltage-frequency scaling with task scheduling decisions.
motivation: Power consumption is critical for processor efficiency, affecting thermal management, data center costs, and mobile device battery life.
method: PowerScope coordinates dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) with intelligent task scheduling on heterogeneous processors. The system dynamically adjusts voltage and frequency levels based on real-time task characteristics and scheduling decisions, enabling fine-grained power optimization across heterogeneous core types.
key_novelty: Joint optimization of DVFS and task scheduling specifically tailored for heterogeneous multi-core architectures.
contributions: Fine-grained power management framework for heterogeneous processors
Coordinated DVFS and task scheduling algorithm
25% power reduction with minimal performance degradation
primary_theme: coordinated power management for heterogeneous processors
